text: probe-done checkpoint: at tick 382 (~6s in) WREN says 'Capsule away. She is holding position beside us.' with no preceding dialogue or prompt; I was still on the bridge turning around and never saw Ines board or leave. No capsule visible through the starboard window.

Possible capsule seen through the port-side bridge window: a tiny dark box with a red light sitting just above the window sill (around x=525,y=425). It is a few pixels across and easy to mistake for a fixture; nothing on screen labels it as Ines's capsule.

Machine load average ~150: game runs at ~1.5 ticks/s (tick 2177->2429 in ~3 real minutes). The 49 s rescue window would take ~20 real minutes, so I fire at ~25 s instead of waiting; perf is from shared host load, not necessarily the game.

After the beam (tick ~3100), facing the comms console: monitor reads 'CAPSULE - engine burn seen, climbing home' but the orange target brackets in the middle of the monitor are empty, and the in-world 'Capsule - Ines' marker through the window also frames nothing visible. The player cannot actually see the capsule they are rescuing.
